newsitem.title: UK: UK's Blair says utility windfall tax is fair.
newsitem.headline: UK's Blair says utility windfall tax is fair.

text.p: Prime Minister Tony Blair told parliament on Wednesday the Labour government's planned windfall tax on the excess profits of monopoly privatised utilities was fair and would be imposed.
"I really don't know how anyone looking at the results at these companies over the past few weeks can doubt the wisdom and the fairness, the basic fairness, of having the windfall tax.

"It is the right, it is the fair way to put in place a jobs and education programme for our young people that is desperately needed in many parts of this country...," Blair said during prime minister's question time in the House of Commons.
"We were elected on that mandate, that was the promise we made and, unlike the previous government, we will carry through our promise," he said.
The tax is expected to be the key part of the government's July 2 budget. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7768
